name: civpulse
description: Search and manage Civic Pulse through authenticated MCP tools and guided civic research, content editing and mapping workflows.

interface.longDescription: Search civic organizations, people, elections, ballot questions, articles, calendars, events and maps. Connect with your Civic Pulse account. Administrators can create, edit and delete content, relationships, stored map features and images; other users can research permitted content and edit their own display name. Includes research, editing and mapping skills.
defaultPrompt: Find civic organizations, people and upcoming elections.
Help me update a Civic Pulse record.
Help me build a map with reusable layers.
